narrative.overview: LIghtJUNction is rendered as one continuous obsidian wall crossed by an oxidized signal. ASCII routes, repository evidence, live shaders, and operating boundaries all belong to the same trace; motion explains causality rather than decorating a portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous wall instead of alternating page templates.
Deterministic ASCII motion as moving evidence, not decoration.
One oxidized signal accent with large areas of low-chroma material.
Open composition around real instruments rather than ornamental cards.
Visible recovery, reduced-motion, keyboard, and ownership boundaries.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Oxidized Signal identifies active causality; it is not a section background, decorative gradient, or general-purpose brand fill.

rules.name: The Evidence Test
rules.body: Monospace must name a state, action, coordinate, value, or source. If it does none of those, use Manrope.

rules.name: The Instrument Exception
rules.body: A surface may lift only when it contains a real tool, artifact, or protected interaction. Narrative copy never becomes a raised card.

dos: Do preserve one continuous material and route across the whole public page.
Do let real state, evidence, and visitor input drive motion.
Do leave large quiet intervals between dense technical scenes.
Do keep content and recovery paths visible before animation finishes.
Do keep reduced-motion output stable and complete.
donts: Don't reintroduce cream-serif editorial templates, black-blue Swiss portfolios, Matrix rain, card walls, or section-by-section theme swaps.
Don't use Oxidized Signal as wallpaper or gradient text.
Don't turn prose into cards, badges, or decorative technical labels.
Don't copy Fable assets, source, drawings, prose, dimensions, or scene order.
Don't expose or weaken Challenge II while changing presentation.
